# New renderings chosen in iliad-068 (Iliad 11.434–542)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| οὔτησε κατ’ ἀσπίδα (11.434; οὐτάω of a thrust that lands on the shield and wounds no one) | "thrust at him, upon the shield" | "stabbed at him on his shield" | "wounded" (the table’s οὐτάω; here nothing is wounded, so it would be false), "struck", "pierced"; a departure from the table’s `l` "wounded", with that reason |
| ἔργαθεν (11.437, ἀπὸ … ἔργαθεν χρόα) | "it kept off" | "it kept off" | "tore", "grazed" (each picks a subject and a picture the Greek does not give); ἔργω "shut out, keep off", the subject left as a bare "it" |
| δῖος Νέστωρ (11.510) | "Nestor, heavenly" | "heavenly Nestor" | "noble", "divine" (reserved for θεῖος); the table’s δῖος "heavenly", extended from Odysseus to Nestor |
| ὠμησταί (of birds, 11.454) | "raw-feeding" | "that feed on raw flesh" | "flesh-eating" and "raw-eating" (the table’s ὠμοφάγος "raw-eating" / "that eat raw flesh" is a different word; ὠμηστής keeps ὠμός "raw" with "feeding") |
| ἐρύουσι (11.454, of birds at a corpse) | "will drag at" | "will drag at" | "will tear", "will devour" (go beyond ἐρύω "drag, draw") |
| κτεριοῦσι (11.455) | "will give funeral rites to" | "will give me funeral rites" | "will bury" (loses κτέρεα, the funeral offerings), "will honour" |
| κεκλόμενοι (11.460) | "calling out" | "called out" | "urging one another on" (the usual sense of κέλομαι, but the Greek has no "one another"), "shouting" |
| ἐξοπίσω ἀνεχάζετο (11.461) | "to the rear was drawing back" | "kept drawing back toward the rear" | "retreating", "withdrawing"; ἀναχάζομαι keeps the table’s "draw back" (11.95) |
| ὅσον κεφαλὴ χάδε φωτός (11.462) | "as much as a man’s head held" | "as loud as a man’s head can hold" | "as loud as he could" (drops the image), "with all his lung"; χανδάνω "hold, contain" |
| ἕπω with ἀμφί (ἀμφὶ δ’ ἄρ’ αὐτὸν Τρῶες ἕπονθ’ 11.474; ἀμφ’ Ὀδυσῆα … Τρῶες ἕπον 11.483) | "kept close" | "kept close" | "followed" (kept for ἕπομαι), "swarmed", "thronged" (too strong a picture); ἕπω "be busy about" |
| θῶες (11.474, 11.479, 11.481) | "jackals" | "jackals" | "wolves", "lions" (λῖς is the lion at 480); the usual identification of θώς |
| ὠμοφάγοι θῶες (11.479) | "raw-eating jackals" | "jackals that eat raw flesh" | follows the table’s ὠμοφάγοισιν "raw-eating" / "that eat raw flesh" |
| κεραὸν ἔλαφον (11.475) | "horned deer" | "horned deer" | "stag" (reserved for ὑψίκερων ἔλαφον), "antlered"; follows the table’s ἔλαφος "deer" |
| νέμος (ἐν νέμεϊ σκιερῷ, 11.480) | "glen" | "glen" | "grove", "glade", "wood" (each picks one of the senses of νέμος "wooded pasture") |
| σίντης (λῖν … σίντην, 11.480–481) | "a ravager" | "a ravaging lion" | "destroyer", "savage" (kept for ἄγριος); σίνομαι "harm" |
| δαίμων (ἐπί τε λῖν ἤγαγε δαίμων, 11.480) | "a power" | "some power" | the table’s δαίμων (6.172), unchanged |
| ἄλλυδις ἄλλος (11.486, "one to one place, another to another") | "one this way, another that" | "one this way and another that" | "hither and thither" (the table’s ἄλλυδις ἄλλῃ is "this way and that"; here ἄλλος "another" makes it a pair of subjects) |
| ἀφυσγετόν (11.495) | "silt" | "silt" | "mud", "rubbish", "refuse" (each picks one of the two senses) |
| δρῦς · πεύκας (11.494) | "oaks" · "pines" | "oaks" · "pines" | "trees" (loses both words), "firs" |
| ὀρώρει · ὄρωρεν (βοὴ δ’ ἄσβεστος, 11.500, 11.530) | "had arisen" · "has arisen" | "had arisen" · "has arisen" | "was rising" (turns the pluperfect and perfect into the imperfect); βοὴ ἄσβεστος "unquenchable war-cry" in `l` and "a war-cry that would never go out" (500) / "that will not go out" (530) in `i`, following the table’s ἄσβεστον κλέος |
| ἱππῆες πεζοί τε (11.529) | "horsemen and men on foot" | "mounted men and men on foot" | "cavalry and infantry", "charioteers"; the table’s πεζοί θ’ ἱππῆές τε (2.810) in reverse order, `i` "mounted" as there |
| προβαλόντες (κακὴν ἔριδα προβαλόντες, 11.529) | "having cast forward" | "having cast forward" | "setting between them", "engaging in"; the exact picture is not clear and the note says so |
| μάστιγι λιγυρῇ (11.532) | "with a clear-sounding whip" | "with a clear-sounding whip" | "shrill" (turned down at 5.526), "whistling"; the table’s λιγυρῇσι "clear-sounding" for λιγυρός, here of a whip, with `l` also "clear-sounding" because "clear whip" is not English |
| ἅρμα · δίφρον (11.533 · 11.535) | "chariot" · "chariot" | "chariot" · "chariot" | "car" and "stool" (δίφρον a seat at 3.424); both words are the chariot here |
| ἐπίσσωτρα (11.537) | "tyres" | "tyres" | "rims" (kept away from ἄντυγες "rails"), "wheel-bands"; the metal bands round a wheel |
| ἀνδρόμεον ὅμιλον (11.538) | "human … throng" | "throng of men" | "crowd of men"; follows the table’s ἀνδρόμεα κρέα "human flesh" in `l`, with `i` as "of men" because "human throng" is not English |
| μίνυνθα δὲ χάζετο δουρός (11.539) | "for a little while he gave ground from the spear" | "gave ground from the spear for only a little while" | "withdrew from the spear", "shrank back" (each decides whose spear); χάζομαι "give ground" as in the table |
| ποθή in Menelaus’ fear (μεγάλη δὲ ποθὴ Δαναοῖσι γένηται, 11.471) | "a great lack for the Danaans" | "a great lack of him" | "longing", "regret"; the table’s ποθή "lack", with "of him" added in `i` for the person who is missed |
